resolved_findings.title: HTTP Basic Authentication over HTTP
resolved_findings.description: The server requests Basic Authentication over unencrypted HTTP.
resolved_findings.recommendation: Force HTTPS before authentication and enable HSTS after validation.

resolved_findings.title: Cookie uses SameSite=None without Secure
resolved_findings.description: SameSite=None cookies should also use Secure.
resolved_findings.recommendation: Set Secure or avoid SameSite=None if cross-site usage is not required.

persistent_findings.title: Cookie missing HttpOnly flag
persistent_findings.description: A cookie is accessible to client-side scripts when HttpOnly is absent.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Set HttpOnly for session or sensitive cookies.

persistent_findings.title: Cookie missing SameSite attribute
persistent_findings.description: A cookie does not declare a SameSite policy.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Set SameSite=Lax or SameSite=Strict unless cross-site usage is required.

persistent_findings.title: Crawler found links outside scope
persistent_findings.description: The crawler discovered links outside the configured scope. They were recorded but not requested.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Review whether any external host should be added to the authorized scope before scanning it.

persistent_findings.title: HTML generator metadata is exposed
persistent_findings.description: The HTML generator metadata can disclose CMS or framework details.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Remove generator metadata if it is not required.

persistent_findings.title: X-Powered-By header discloses technology information
persistent_findings.description: The X-Powered-By header can reveal backend technology details to attackers.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Remove or reduce technology-identifying response headers where practical.

persistent_findings.title: Server header discloses version information
persistent_findings.description: The Server header appears to include product version information.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Avoid exposing precise server versions unless there is an operational reason.

persistent_findings.title: Clickjacking protection header is missing
persistent_findings.description: The response does not include X-Frame-Options or a CSP frame-ancestors directive.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Set frame-ancestors in Content-Security-Policy or use X-Frame-Options where appropriate.

persistent_findings.title: Content-Security-Policy header is missing
persistent_findings.description: The response does not include the Content-Security-Policy header.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Define an appropriate Content-Security-Policy header for this application.

persistent_findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options nosniff is missing
persistent_findings.description: The browser may try to infer content types when nosniff is absent.

persistent_findings.title: Permissions-Policy header is missing
persistent_findings.description: The response does not include the Permissions-Policy header.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Define an appropriate Permissions-Policy header for this application.

persistent_findings.title: Referrer-Policy header is missing
persistent_findings.description: The response does not include the Referrer-Policy header.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Define an appropriate Referrer-Policy header for this application.

persistent_findings.title: HTTP is not redirected to HTTPS
persistent_findings.description: The requested HTTP URL remains available without being upgraded to HTTPS.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS and consider enabling HSTS after verification.

persistent_findings.title: JavaScript endpoint references discovered
persistent_findings.description: Client-side JavaScript contains URL references that expand the passive review surface.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Review these endpoints against the authorized scope before deciding whether later validation is needed.

persistent_findings.title: JavaScript references endpoints outside scope
persistent_findings.description: Client-side JavaScript references hosts outside the configured scope. They were recorded but not requested.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Confirm whether those hosts belong to the engagement before scanning them.

persistent_findings.title: JavaScript references sensitive-looking parameter names
persistent_findings.description: Some JavaScript-discovered URLs contain parameter names commonly associated with authentication, sessions or secrets. Values are redacted.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Review how these parameters are generated, logged and exposed. Do not include raw secrets in reports.

persistent_findings.title: HTTP method DELETE is advertised
persistent_findings.description: DELETE may allow destructive actions if authorization is weak.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Disable unnecessary HTTP methods or enforce strict authorization before use.

persistent_findings.title: Open TCP ports detected
persistent_findings.description: The limited TCP connectivity check found open ports on the target host. This is inventory evidence, not exploitation.
persistent_findings.recommendation: Review whether each exposed service is expected, patched and covered by the authorized audit scope.
